scope: Public checkpoint/source/package metadata and static Python AST/text review only
weight_identity_scope: Publisher LFS metadata; model weights not downloaded or locally hashed by this review

architecture.motion_path: A video T,H,W grid is split into consecutive groups of at most four frames. Joint vision attention includes temporal positional embeddings; the projector temporally pools each group and spatially merges 2x2 patches.
architecture.image_list_limit: Separately encoded images have T=1 and do not use the same joint four-frame motion attention.
architecture.upstream_vllm_evidence: Pinned official evaluation adapter raises NotImplementedError for use_vllm.

current_runtime.source: configs/serving/actual-packages.json plus static inspection of the lock-pinned Transformers wheel

blockers.detail: Imports BASE_VIDEO_PROCESSOR_DOCSTRING from transformers.video_processing_utils; the verified 5.17.0 wheel module has no such definition/import/dynamic module __getattr__. Unchanged processor cannot import through this reference.

prepare_inputs_for_generation dereferences its local cache_position[0]. Transformers 5.17 does not maintain this as a generate caller kwarg; its remote-code compatibility path creates cache_position only inside the returned model_inputs dictionary. Requires an audited port or an older compatible isolated library branch.

current_runtime.a100_cuda_assessment: BF16/SDPA are plausible on the already working A100/Torch CUDA12.9 base. This review did not test candidate kernels, peak memory, co-residency, a flash-attn wheel ABI, or driver compatibility.

proposed_isolated_runtime.status: Static-compatible candidate profile only; no installation/import/load validation
proposed_isolated_runtime.publisher_4570_yank_reason: Error in the setup causing installation issues
proposed_isolated_runtime.torch_candidate: Retain locked Torch2.13.0+cu129 and Torchvision0.28.0+cu129 only in a separate tested image; no compatibility proof is claimed.
proposed_isolated_runtime.isolation_reason: Transformers4.57 dependency constraints can conflict with current5.17/vLLM dependencies; do not downgrade the running service. Resolve and hash a dedicated minimal environment.

attention_backends.sdpa_profile_requirement: Set the custom vision_config.attn_impl to sdpa before constructing the model, separately select text SDPA, and attest both effective values.
attention_backends.sdpa_scaling_limit: Custom SDPA allocates a boolean [1,N,N] mask over ALL unmerged vision patches in the packet. Bound frames/resolution before allocation; no full-native long-video throughput claim.
attention_backends.eager_static_concern: The eager implementation adds a boolean allowed-attention mask to logits rather than masking disallowed blocks to negative infinity; cross-group behavior differs from the SDPA/varlen path. No candidate execution was used to assess this.
attention_backends.flash_attn_import_behavior: If package availability check fails, flash_attn_varlen_func becomes None; default custom vision FA2 path would still call it. Pin and independently test any compiled extension if FA2 is chosen.

timestamps.group_timestamp: Midpoint of first and last timestamp in each up-to-four-frame group
timestamps.vfr_warning: Average source FPS arithmetic does not preserve arbitrary original PTS; native source PTS must remain authoritative.
timestamps.required_adapter_clock_proof: Bind every sampled ordinal/frame ID to original source_pts/time_base and verify the actual grouped, rendered processor timestamp sequence. A native-PTS metadata override/subclass or tick-clock scheme needs its own CPU proof for this processor; do not reuse the TimeLens two-frame proof unchanged.
timestamps.precision_limit: One-decimal pooled model prompt timestamps cannot establish an exact frame boundary. Report model intervals as coarse proposals with source-frame brackets and uncertainty; never round a proposal into fake millisecond certainty.

offline_safety.review_scope_limit: Static review of the five listed core modules, not a proof about all transitive library behavior.
upstream_network_surfaces: Parent processors can fetch remote image/video URLs
Full upstream evaluation can use cloud judges and download datasets
required_execution_controls: Pinned local snapshot with all config/tokenizer/custom-source/shard hashes verified
local_files_only=True with HF_HUB_OFFLINE and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE plus telemetry disabled
Isolated container network disabled, no ports, no outbound credentials
Only accepted owned local sources or in-memory RGB frames; no URL/data-URL media
Read-only model/source mounts and bounded writable scratch/module cache
No upstream evaluation judge, remote API, verbose private-input logging, audio decoding, or private response printing

minimal_adapter_contract.kind: Separate experimental native-video physical-fact HF provider, not a legal verdict provider
inputs: Accepted owned source and content SHA-256
Full original source PTS ledger and explicit packet coverage
Chronological native-video RGB packet with no implicit re-sampling
Pinned physical question IDs from the existing19-fact taxonomy; no organizer labels/filenames/verdicts in prompts
Optional exact original anchor image for frame-specific facts, distinguished from surrounding video context
minimal_adapter_contract.processor: Use the custom VideoChat3Processor; pass a video array as videos plus its reviewed VideoChat3 metadata. Use do_sample_frames=False for externally decoded packets. Do not flatten chronological video into independent image prompts. Fix/attest resize recipe, 14-pixel patches and28-pixel spatial divisibility, video_grid_thw, up-to-four-frame timestamp groups and output token cap.
minimal_adapter_contract.generation: Explicit do_sample=False, num_beams=1, fixed seed, bounded max_new_tokens and deadline/cancel; override publisher generation_config do_sample=True. Validate generated continuation only; keep raw response/tokens private.

facts.supporting_frame_ids: only source IDs actually supplied; anchor-only for exact frame facts

output.coarse_temporal_proposals: Optional bounded intervals; separately bind to source-frame brackets and retain quantization/coverage uncertainty

minimal_adapter_contract.validation: Reject unexpected IDs/fields, unsupported citations, malformed JSON, out-of-window intervals and invented source references. Window facts never become per-frame labels by broadcasting. Unseen/occluded/incomplete procedure context stays unclear; no candidate must not become no_violation.
minimal_adapter_contract.legal_output: Existing independently verified rule catalog and applicability/exception/temporal/evidence gates only; never ask the model to invent Kazakhstan law or paragraph text.
minimal_adapter_contract.training_and_release: Machine labels remain provisional; keep the locked split and final blind set. Do not promote without actual local comparisons and repeatability/latency evidence. Human operational confirmation remains a separate immutable ledger.

reuse: Owned-source validation and content hash binding
Full native PTS decode ledger and bounded sampling infrastructure
Offline snapshot/hash checks and private logging policy
Persistent-run resource accounting, deadline/cancellation skeleton and raw result provenance
replace_or_reprove: Hard-coded Qwen3VL class/config identity and loader
Patch16/two-frame temporal grid and clock proof
Manifest identity and runtime package pins
Model output validation for physical-fact JSON
timelens_reuse.recommended_next_step: Finish the existing small TimeLens pilot independently. Prepare a separate4.57.1-compatible VideoChat3 native-video adapter; after authorized public-weight staging and a coordinated GPU slot, run bounded generated-video load/forward smoke before any train/validation private-media experiment.
